scope: Complete 64 candidate runs. Actual play-card selection preview joined by player/card instance/round to the first unused play entry, then its first expected number of scan history steps. First-node restriction supports this join, but inserted scan triggers could affect repeated scans; inspect mismatches individually. Match counts measure preview realization and are not causal score gains. Unmatched is unknown, not a failure or wasted card.
